name: The noble eightfold path as defined in DN 22

stages.name: sammādiṭṭhi
stages.description: knowledge of suffering, origin, cessation and the way

stages.name: sammāvācā
stages.description: abstaining from false, divisive, harsh speech and idle chatter

stages.name: sammākammanta
stages.description: abstaining from killing, taking what is not given, sexual misconduct

stages.name: sammāājīva
stages.description: giving up wrong livelihood, making a living rightly
